append_only_note: The original record is NOT modified (R6). This record supersedes its LAS@NYL row and every aggregate derived from it. Any future reader must take the WNBA night numbers from HERE.

error.what: LAS@NYL was recorded final '85-81' in away-home order (LAS 85, NYL 81, home LOSS, side=false, brier 0.5607, margin_err -12.3).
error.truth: NYL (home, Liberty) won 85-81. Source phrasing 'Liberty 85-81 Sparks' is WINNER-FIRST, not away-home order. Correct away-home final: LAS 81 @ NYL 85, home_win = 1.
error.mechanism: ORIENTATION FLIP — the exact failure mode this repository documented on 2026-08-08 (ATH@BOS) and in the crosswalk hazard note: a flipped pair stays internally self-consistent, so arithmetic checks cannot see it. This instance was a transcription-convention error by the operator, not a source error.
error.detection_trail: (1) re-read of the source phrasing against the winner-first convention; (2) the erroneous record was internally INCONSISTENT — its own rows implied sides 2/3 while the night block said '3/3' (a hardcoded string), which is itself a defect: aggregates must be computed from the rows, never typed.
error.why_gates_missed_it: winner_name_mismatch() only covers the MLB results.csv + evidence-file path; this WNBA provisional analysis file is outside that check's scope. Gap recorded below.

lifetime_prospective.small_sample_guard: P(6/6 | the model's own stated probabilities) = product of the six side probabilities = 0.4324 x 0.4119 = 0.178. Six favourites in the 70-80 pct band landing is unusual-but-not-remarkable; nothing here licenses a promotion claim.

corrected_aggregates.margin_tail_finding_updated: The finding STRENGTHENS slightly on side but the LAS@NYL exhibit changes character: corrected margin_err is -4.31 (mild), not -12.3. The tail-compression evidence remains ATL@CON (pred -5.8, actual -35, err -29.2) and 8/12 CHI@GSV (pred +8.3, actual +20). Successor-prereg candidate #3 stands, evidence base restated honestly.

process_actions: Standing rule adopted for provisional analysis records: night-level 'sides' and 'brier' aggregates must be COMPUTED from the rows in the same record, never hardcoded — the hardcoded '3/3' both masked and (accidentally) matched the corrected truth here, which is worse, not better.

Gap noted: winner-name verification is only enforced for MLB results.csv rows with evidence files. WNBA provisional records have no equivalent check. Candidate fix (roadmap, not applied tonight): extend winner_name_mismatch() to accept WNBA evidence records carrying a verbatim winner name.
grading_status: Still PROVISIONAL, tier-3, ungraded. Official grading of the 8/13 WNBA card waits for tier-1 capture; the registered forecasts in data/wnba/forecasts/2026-08-13_card.json are untouched and sealed.
